# finalize.densify_healpix_map { #healpyxel.finalize.densify_healpix_map }

```python
finalize.densify_healpix_map(sparse_df, nside, fill_value=np.nan)
```

Create a complete HEALPix grid by filling empty cells with fill_value.

Expands a sparse DataFrame (only observed cells) to the full HEALPix
grid with all ``12 * nside²`` cells. Unobserved cells are filled with
``fill_value`` (NaN by default).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type         | Description                                                         | Default    |
|------------|--------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| sparse_df  | pd.DataFrame | DataFrame with ``healpix_id`` index (sparse — only observed cells). | _required_ |
| nside      | int          | HEALPix nside parameter.                                            | _required_ |
| fill_value | float        | Value for empty cells. Default: ``NaN``.                            | `np.nan`   |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Dense DataFrame with RangeIndex ``[0, 12*nside²)`` as index, containing all HEALPix cells. |
